turnos.t: Causal loop diagrams. Write variables, things that can increase or decrease, joined by arrows. Plus means both change in the same direction. Minus means they change in opposite directions. Then label the loop R for reinforcing or B for balancing.

Count the minus signs. An even number, zero or two, gives a reinforcing loop. An odd number gives a balancing loop. The ice–albedo loop: higher temperature, less sea ice, lower albedo, more radiation absorbed, higher temperature. Two minus links, so it's reinforcing.
